text:
morgan: taking over for the night. quick handoff: seeing elevated kvcache eviction rate in eu-west-1 since ~22:03 UTC, causing embed generation p95 to jump ~250ms for a subset of tenants. incident id INC-2026-042. impact: hosted embeddings only, some tail latency, no widespread 5xx but a few timeouts reported by retrying clients.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-042 detected — KV_CACHE_EVICTIONS high in eu-west-1. Alert threshold crossed (evictions > 500/min). Link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/INC-2026-042

alex: noted. are we sure this is eviction churn and not a network blip? can you paste the eviction metric query?

morgan: here's the quick query I used (prom):
```
avg_over_time(kvcache_evictions_total{region="eu-west-1"}[5m])
```
shows spike from ~80/min to ~620/min. also saw pod OOMs on kvcache-3 for a few seconds then restart loop.

sasha: I'm on the kvcache PR (reduce mem footprint + pin hotspot keys). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kvcache/pulls/331 — can roll a canary once we validate. ETA for canary is 02:30 UTC.

kevin: can we route traffic away from eu-west for embeddings while we stabilize? what's the routing fallback state?

morgan: I enabled fallback routing to us-west for non-PII tenants at 22:15 UTC (policy routed-backup=eu->us-west). command I ran: `rbacctl route set --from eu-west-1 --to us-west-1 --filter non_pii --dry=false`. link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-evictions

alex: good call. CS reported one enterprise (acct: acme-inc) still seeing ~5% p95 increase — I'll ping cs-rep to reach out. cs-rep: can you confirm outreach? :phone:

cs-rep: ping received, will open a support note and reach out to the tenant ops contact. leaving message now.

morgan: mitigation steps applied so far:
- scaled kvcache pool +2 nodes in eu-west-1 (temporary)
- toggled fallback routing to us-west for non-PII
- restarted kvcache-3 after applying OOM guard config
- canary deploy queued for 02:30 UTC with PR #331 (5% traffic)

sasha: canary rollout plan: 5% -> 20% after 10m if eviction rate drops and no increases in errors. health checks: `embed_p95`, `kv_eviction_rate`, `kv_pod_ooms`. rollback threshold: embed_p95 > baseline + 150ms or any pod OOM during canary.

kevin: I'll keep an eye on cross-region bandwidth while fallback is on — want to avoid cascading throttles.

morgan: monitoring dashboards to watch: https://dashboards.redwood/ops/kvcache-eu, embed p95 panel, node memory usage. alerts suppressed for noisy eviction flaps for next 40m to avoid alert fatigue (manual suppression).

alex: any blockers for the handoff?

morgan: nothing immediate. blocker is will-the-canary-fix-memory-leak; sasha has the PR but needs +1 from infra for the canary image build. sasha, can you ping infra?

sasha: already pinged infra-engineer in DM, they said build should be ready in ~30m.

morgan: OK. my shift notes / next steps: monitor eviction rate, watch canary once it starts, coordinate with CS for acme-inc, if evictions climb re-enable full-block fallback to us-west (will require manual approval). leaving my slack open for the next hour, I’ll check back at 02:25 UTC to kick canary. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks — taking over if things spike after 23:15 UTC.

oncall-bot: NOTE: suppression set for alert KV_CACHE_EVICTIONS in eu-west-1 for 40m by morgan.

morgan: handoff complete. contact: @morgan (pager) / pager +1-555-0102. playbook link: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/kvcache-evictions.
